tooltip.primeva.phial: Used as an offering on the Infusion Altar.
tooltip.primeva.lens.1: Hold right-click while aiming at something to perceive it.
tooltip.primeva.lens.2: With an item in your other hand, perceives that item.
tooltip.primeva.grimoire.2: Use on the Infusion Altar to start the ritual.
tooltip.primeva.umbral_blade: Steals life and withers the target.
tooltip.primeva.unknown: Unknown essences (use the Lens of Perception)
msg.primeva.scan_nothing: There is nothing to perceive in %s.
msg.primeva.miasma_heavy: The miasma weighs on the air...
msg.primeva.distiller_busy: The distiller is already processing another item.
msg.primeva.distiller_low: Needs at least 5 of one essence to fill a phial.
msg.primeva.altar_empty: Place an item on the altar first.
msg.primeva.altar_fail: The ritual collapsed! The offerings came back, but miasma spread.
research.primeva.infusion.desc: An item on the Altar and offerings on Pedestals within 4 blocks. The ritual drains essence from nearby Jars, and instability grows over time. Mirrored pedestal pairs, Containment Pillars and Runic Stabilizers hold the ritual together.
research.primeva.primeval_metal.desc: Iron infused with Terra and Ember becomes a metal that conducts essence.
research.primeva.miasma.desc: Every distillation and infusion leaves residue. In excess it corrupts soil, kills plants, raises fog and draws wraiths. Corruption Sites in the world spread miasma until purified.
research.primeva.gale_boots.desc: Boots light as wind: higher step, more speed and soft landings.
research.primeva.umbral_blade.desc: A sword that drinks the life of those it wounds and makes them wither.
research.primeva.transmutation.desc: Rearrange the essence of common minerals into precious gems. Unstable and polluting.
gui.primeva.insight_hint: Accumulated insight. Use the Lens to gain more.
gui.primeva.hidden_ritual: The ritual will be revealed once you complete this research.
tooltip.primeva.crystal: Pure, stable essence. Worth 25 insight at the Study Table.
tooltip.primeva.eclipse_reaper.1: Every strike reaps everything around the target.
tooltip.primeva.eclipse_reaper.2: Drains life and inflicts Wither II.
tooltip.primeva.primeval_heart.2: +10 permanent health, miasma immunity and +50% insight.
msg.primeva.need_pillars: This ritual needs %s Containment Pillars around it (found %s).
msg.primeva.need_catalyst: This ritual needs a Primordial Catalyst beneath the altar.
msg.primeva.need_study: You have not researched the Study Table yet.
research.primeva.study.desc: Study phials (+3) and crystals (+25) to turn essence into insight. Sneak to study the whole stack.
research.primeva.containment.desc: Pillars that hold the ritual in place. Tier II rituals need 4 pillars and tier III need 8. Every 3 pillars remove 1 instability. Also teaches the Runic Stabilizer (up to 8 count).
research.primeva.crystals.desc: Compress four phials into one stable crystal. The basis of all advanced knowledge.
research.primeva.primeval_armor.desc: Better than netherite. The full set grants Resistance and wards off miasma.
research.primeva.catalyst.desc: A star's heart that opens tier III rituals. Place it beneath the altar.
research.primeva.eclipse_reaper.desc: The Umbral Blade awakens. Sweeping strikes that drain life and wither.
research.primeva.archmage_crown.desc: Flight, night vision, fall immunity and double insight when studying the world.
research.primeva.primeval_heart.desc: The pinnacle of alchemy: ascend beyond mortal flesh.
tooltip.primeva.wand_ember: Fires three fireballs in a fan.
tooltip.primeva.wand_tide: Heals and protects you and nearby allies.
tooltip.primeva.wand_terra: Excavates a 3x3x3 area of soft blocks.
tooltip.primeva.wand_gale: Dash where you look, with slow falling.
tooltip.primeva.wand_lumen: Creates light where you aim and reveals enemies.
tooltip.primeva.wand_umbra: Drains the life of the creature you aim at.
tooltip.primeva.wand_refill: Refills itself using %s from your inventory
msg.primeva.wand_empty: Out of charge! Carry %s in your inventory.
tooltip.primeva.elixir_vigor: Strength II, Speed II and Haste II for 3 min.
tooltip.primeva.elixir_abyss: Night vision, water breathing and Conduit Power for 8 min.
tooltip.primeva.elixir_primeval: Regeneration II, Absorption IV, Resistance II and Fire Resistance.
tooltip.primeva.primeval_pickaxe: Mines 3x3. Sneak to mine a single block.
research.primeva.elemental_wands.desc: Channel Ember, Tide and Gale into spells. Charge is restored by drinking phials from your inventory.
research.primeva.greater_wands.desc: Terra, Lumen and Umbra need crystals to be tamed: excavation, light and life drain.
research.primeva.elixirs.desc: Crystallized essences dissolved into potions far stronger than the cauldron's.
research.primeva.primeval_tools.desc: A pickaxe forged in essence that mines in a 3x3 area.
jei.primeva.info.phial: Essence phials are not crafted. Put items in the Essence Distiller (with fire, lava, magma or a lit campfire below) and click it with an Empty Phial once it holds at least 5 of one essence.
jei.primeva.info.distiller: Click with items to distill. Needs heat below. Click with an Empty Phial to fill it with the most abundant essence. Sneak empty-handed to take the item out. Distilling creates miasma.
jei.primeva.info.corrupted_soil: Appears on its own when chunk miasma exceeds 15. Turns back into dirt when the chunk is clean. Use the Purifying Beacon.
jei.primeva.info.lens: Hold right-click aiming at blocks, creatures or an item in your other hand. Every new thing perceived gives essence points for Grimoire research. Bosses are worth a lot!
jei.primeva.info.altar: Place the central item on the altar and offerings on Arcane Pedestals within 4 blocks. Activate with the Grimoire. Symmetric pedestals and Containment Pillars reduce instability.
jei.primeva.info.pillar: Tier II rituals need 4 Containment Pillars around the altar (within 6 blocks). Tier III needs 8. Every 3 pillars remove 1 instability.
jei.primeva.info.catalyst: Place directly beneath the Infusion Altar to unlock tier III rituals.
jei.primeva.info.study: Click with phials (+3) or crystals (+25) to turn essence into insight. Sneak to study the whole stack. Requires the Study Table research.
jei.primeva.info.wand: Durability is the wand's charge. When it runs out it drinks a phial of its essence from your inventory and recharges +16.
tooltip.primeva.focus_frost: Freezes the target (damage + slowness) and turns water into ice and lava into obsidian.
tooltip.primeva.focus_shock: Lightning that chains between up to 4 enemies.
tooltip.primeva.focus_excavation: Breaks the targeted block up to 16 blocks away.
tooltip.primeva.focus_exchange: Swaps the targeted block with the block in your other hand. Sneak: 3x3.
tooltip.primeva.focus_hole: Opens an 8-block tunnel that closes after 10 s.
tooltip.primeva.salt_1: Use on a bookshelf: creates a Grimoire.
tooltip.primeva.salt_2: Use on a water cauldron: creates an Arcane Crucible.
tooltip.primeva.void_seed: A seed of nothing. It throbs in your hand.
tooltip.primeva.runic_ring: In inventory: a 4-heart runic shield that recharges out of combat.
msg.primeva.crucible_dumped: You emptied the crucible. The essence spills into the air...
msg.primeva.exchange_need_block: Hold a block in your other hand.
research.primeva.salt.desc: Three crystal shards, redstone and quicksilver become a salt that awakens matter. Sprinkle it on a bookshelf to make a Grimoire, or on a water cauldron to make the Arcane Crucible.
research.primeva.crucible.desc: Fill with water and put heat below. Throw items in: they melt into essences. A catalyst transforms the mix. Sneak + empty hand empties it (creates miasma).
research.primeva.arcanite.desc: Iron steeped in Terra, Umbra and Lumen becomes Arcanite: enchantable tools and armor above iron.
research.primeva.foci.desc: Foci with their own charge, refilled with phials: Frost, Shock, Excavation and Flame.
research.primeva.eternal_flame.desc: Ember and Lumen trapped in a fire that never dies. Also teaches Arcane Fuel.
research.primeva.goggles.desc: See the essences of what you look at without the Lens (only for things you studied).
research.primeva.runic_ring.desc: A ring that weaves a shield of runes around you while you are not hurt.
research.primeva.advanced_foci.desc: Rare foci: Exchange, Portable Hole and Radiance (heals and burns undead).
research.primeva.arcane_devices.desc: The Hungry Chest swallows whatever falls on it. The Arcane Lamp lights up dark corners around it.
research.primeva.voidsteel.desc: An ender pearl drowned in Umbra sprouts a Void Seed. From it comes a metal that repairs itself.
jei.primeva.info.crucible: Fill with a water bucket, put fire/lava/magma/campfire below and throw items in. Can also be made by using Primordial Salt on a water cauldron.
jei.primeva.info.salt: Sprinkle on a bookshelf to get a Grimoire, or on a water cauldron to create the Arcane Crucible.
jei.primeva.info.hungry_chest: Stores items that fall on top of it by itself (27 slots). Works with hoppers.
jei.primeva.info.arcane_lamp: Places invisible lights in dark spots within 14 blocks. Breaking the lamp removes them.
jei.primeva.info.runic_ring: Keep in your inventory: get up to 4 absorption hearts that recharge 8 s after taking damage.
jei.primeva.info.goggles: Shows the target's essences under the crosshair. Values only show for things you studied with the Lens.
jei.primeva.info.vermilion: Common underground ore (Y -48 to 48). Also made in the Crucible from redstone.
jei.primeva.info.amber: Ore in hills and mountains (Y 16 to 112). Also made in the Crucible from honeycomb.
jei.primeva.info.shards: Crystal clusters glow on cave floors. Break them for shards. 4 shards + empty phial = full phial.
jei.primeva.info.trees: Argent and Elder trees grow rarely in forests and plains.
jei.primeva.info.foci: Right-click to use. Charge is restored by drinking phials of the focus essence from your inventory.
jei.primeva.info.voidsteel: Repairs 1 durability every 2 s while in your inventory.
tooltip.primeva.ember_pickaxe: Mines the whole ore vein at once.
tooltip.primeva.gale_sword: Launches what it hits. Right-click: a gust all around.
tooltip.primeva.lumen_hoe: Harvests and replants ripe crops in 5x5; otherwise tills 3x3.
tooltip.primeva.essence_amulet: In inventory: 30% chance for wands and foci to use no charge.
tooltip.primeva.verdant_charm: In inventory: cures poison, wither, hunger and nausea, and slowly feeds you.
tooltip.primeva.pocket_mirror: Sneak on a chest: bind. Right-click: sends your other-hand item to the chest.
tooltip.primeva.grapple: Pulls you to the targeted block (up to 32 blocks).
tooltip.primeva.seal_harvest: The golem harvests and replants crops near its home.
tooltip.primeva.seal_pickup: The golem picks up items near its home.
tooltip.primeva.seal_guard: The golem attacks monsters near its home.
tooltip.primeva.seal_use: Click an Arcane Golem with the seal.
tooltip.primeva.golem_1: Use on a chest: the golem spawns and the chest becomes its home.
tooltip.primeva.golem_2: Give it a seal to pick its task.
tooltip.primeva.golem_3: Sneak with an empty hand: pick the golem up.
tooltip.primeva.curio_ancient: Use to study it and gain insight.
tooltip.primeva.curio_abyss: Use to study it and gain insight.
tooltip.primeva.curio_gear: Use to study it and gain insight.
tooltip.primeva.curio_specimen: Use to study it and gain insight.
msg.primeva.mirror_unbound: Sneak and click a chest to bind the mirror.
msg.primeva.mirror_lost: The bound chest can't be found (is it loaded?).
research.primeva.golemancy.desc: Use the golem on a chest: it becomes its home. Seals give it tasks. Sneak + click with an item: add/remove it from the golem's filter.
research.primeva.elemental_tools.desc: Arcanite tools infused with an essence: vein pickaxe, tree-felling axe, 3x3 shovel, gale sword and a harvesting hoe.
research.primeva.advanced_seals.desc: Guard Seal (hunts monsters near home) and Stocking Seal (distributes items from the home chest to nearby chests).
research.primeva.traveler_boots.desc: Light boots: step assist, more speed and higher jumps. Simpler than the Gale Boots.
research.primeva.trinkets.desc: Steadfast Girdle, Essence Amulet and Verdant Charm. They work just by being in your inventory.
research.primeva.grapple.desc: A hook that pulls you to where you aim.
research.primeva.pocket_mirror.desc: A mirror tied to a chest: send items to it from anywhere.
research.primeva.crimson_cult.desc: Cultists who worship the miasma lurk in the dark with scythes. Their cloth makes armor and the Crimson Blade can be recreated.
jei.primeva.info.golem: Use the Arcane Golem on a chest to create it (the chest becomes its home). Click it with a seal to set its task: Harvest, Pickup, Guard, Lumber or Stocking. It works around its home and shows what it carries in its hand.
jei.primeva.info.crimson: Crimson Cultists lurk in the dark, scythe in hand. They drop Crimson Cloth, loot bags, sometimes their Crimson Scythe and, rarely, the Crimson Rites.
jei.primeva.info.loot: Loot bags and curiosities show up in structure chests (dungeons, mineshafts, temples, strongholds...) and from cultists. Curiosities give insight when used.
tooltip.primeva.seal_lumber: The golem fells trees near its home and replants saplings.
tooltip.primeva.seal_stock: The golem moves items from its home chest to nearby chests that already hold the same item.
tooltip.primeva.herald_sigil: Use on the ground to summon the Crimson Herald. Be ready.
tooltip.primeva.crimson_scepter: Right-click: a row of fangs bursts from the ground ahead of you.
msg.primeva.jar_full: The jar is full or holds another essence.
msg.primeva.jar_vented: You emptied the jar. The essence spills into the air...
msg.primeva.herald_disabled: The Herald is disabled in the server config.
jei.primeva.info.jar: The Jar holds one type of essence and keeps it when broken. Click with a phial to pour, or with an empty phial to fill. Sneak: vent it (creates miasma). Tubes carry essence from Distillers to Jars; Filter Tubes let only one essence through. The Crucible draws what a recipe lacks from linked jars, and jars within 6 blocks of the Altar count as phials in rituals. With the Goggles of Revealing you can see what jars, crucibles and distillers contain.
jei.primeva.info.herald: The Crimson Herald leads the cult: 120 hearts, a boss bar, fangs and vexes, summons cultists and teleports when hurt. Summon it with the Herald's Sigil. Drops the Crimson Scepter.

gui.primeva.puzzle_unsolved: ○ The anchors are not linked yet

warp.primeva.whisper.1: You hear footsteps behind you. No one is there.
warp.primeva.whisper.3: The essences sing in a forgotten tongue.
warp.primeva.whisper.4: For a moment, the shadows move on their own.
warp.primeva.vision: A vision tears through your mind... you understand something about %s.
warp.primeva.phantom: Something passes through the wall and comes for you.
warp.primeva.hunger: A hunger that is not yours takes over your body.
warp.primeva.ambush: The Crimson Cult has caught your scent.
warp.primeva.nightmare: You wake up inside a nightmare.
tooltip.primeva.lucidity_tonic: Drink: clears the temporary mind mark and 1 permanent.
tooltip.primeva.research_scroll: Spent each time you complete a research in the Grimoire.
research.primeva.infusion.page1: The ancients called infusion "the marriage of things". Each offering lends its essence to the central item, but the altar always charges a price: essence from the jars, patience and courage. When instability passes its limit, the ritual collapses and devours part of what it was given.
research.primeva.miasma.page1: Miasma is not poison: it is what remains when essence is torn out by force. It gathers in the ground, kills plants, raises a purple fog and, when it grows too thick, gains a will of its own. Corruption Sites are old wounds in the world that never closed.
research.primeva.salt.page1: Primordial Salt is essence crystallized into powder. Sprinkled on a bookshelf, it awakens the knowledge sleeping in books. On the water of a cauldron, it teaches iron to cook matter itself.
research.primeva.purification.page1: To purify is to return essence to its place. The Beacon works slowly, the Incense works fast, and the Lucidity Tonic does the same inside your head. None of them undoes what was learned.
research.primeva.eternal_flame.page1: A flame that burns Lumen instead of wood. It floats in the air without falling, gives no heat and never goes out. Alchemists hung hundreds of them in forbidden libraries.
research.primeva.transmutation.page1: Diamonds and emeralds are not rare by nature: they are rare because Terra takes long to rearrange itself. Transmutation hurries the process and pays for haste with miasma.
research.primeva.study.page1: The Study Table turns stored essence into insight. A phial teaches little; a crystal teaches much. Those who study too much Umbra begin to hear things.
research.primeva.crystals.page1: Four compressed phials become a stable crystal. It is the first step towards the alchemy that changes the world, and the last before the one that changes you.
research.primeva.primeval_metal.page1: Iron bathed in Terra and Ember learns to carry essence the way copper carries electricity. Every magical tool begins here.
research.primeva.crucible.page1: The crucible is a stomach. Everything that falls in is digested into essence, and the right catalyst makes the mixture reborn as something else. Pouring a full crucible on the ground is asking for miasma.
research.primeva.essence_logistics.page1: Carrying phials is for apprentices. The master lets essence flow on its own through copper and quicksilver tubes, keeps it all in jars and only worries about leaks.
research.primeva.arcanite.page1: Arcanite is iron that remembers where it came from. Lighter, sharper and far easier to enchant. The full set makes the body more agile.
research.primeva.elixirs.page1: Cauldron potions are remedies. Elixirs are promises: strength, breath and life borrowed from a crystallized essence.
research.primeva.voidsteel.page1: An ender pearl, drowned in Umbra, sprouts a seed of nothing. The metal born from it mends itself, as if the void could not stand being broken.
research.primeva.elemental_wands.page1: The wand is only a channel. Essence does the work: Ember burns, Tide heals, Gale pushes. Each spell drinks the wand's charge, and each phial gives some back.
research.primeva.foci.page1: Amber keeps insects for millions of years. Cut, it keeps spells. Foci are the most precise way to cast essence into the world.
research.primeva.advanced_foci.page1: Swapping one stone for another from afar. Opening a hole in a wall that closes on its own. Small tricks for those who forgot the world was not meant to obey.
research.primeva.greater_wands.page1: Terra, Lumen and Umbra refuse to be channeled by just anyone. Only a wand with a crystal heart can bear their weight.
research.primeva.containment.page1: Crying obsidian pillars pin the ritual like nails pin a tent. Runic Stabilizers do the same more elegantly, and an altar surrounded by them almost never collapses.
research.primeva.catalyst.page1: The Catalyst is a star's heart torn from the Wither. Beneath the altar, it allows rituals that bend reality itself, at the cost of a mark on the mind.
research.primeva.primeval_heart.page1: No book describes what happens after. It is only known that whoever forges the Primeval Heart stops being merely human.
research.primeva.wraiths.page1: Wraiths are not souls: they are miasma that learned to have a shape. They pass through walls, hate clean air and leave a heavy Umbra residue when they fall apart.
research.primeva.crimson_cult.page1: The Crimson Cult believes miasma is the next step of life. Its members walk in the dark with scythes and robes the color of dried blood, and they never walk alone for long.
research.primeva.herald.page1: The Herald speaks for the cult. They say he was once an alchemist who read the Crimson Rites to the end. Summoning him is easy; surviving him is not.
research.primeva.gale_boots.page1: Boots that keep a bit of wind. Longer steps, softer falls.
research.primeva.umbral_blade.page1: A blade that drinks a little from whoever it wounds. Those who forge it say it also drinks a little from whoever holds it.
research.primeva.goggles.page1: With these lenses, the essences you have studied float over everything. They also show what is inside jars, crucibles and distillers.
research.primeva.runic_ring.page1: The ring's runes light up when no one is hurting you, and form a shield that waits for the next blow.
research.primeva.traveler_boots.page1: Made for those who walk a lot and think little about the road.
research.primeva.arcane_devices.page1: The Hungry Chest eats whatever falls on it. The Arcane Lamp scatters invisible lights into dark corners. Small comforts of a well-kept laboratory.
research.primeva.elemental_tools.page1: Tools that understand what they break: the pickaxe follows the vein, the axe knows where the tree ends, the shovel clears the way in three directions.
research.primeva.trinkets.page1: Simple but useful charms: one that keeps the ground under your feet, one that saves essence and one that keeps the body healthy.
research.primeva.grapple.page1: A hook with an Arcanite tip and an enchanted rope. Aim, fire and fly.
research.primeva.pocket_mirror.page1: Bind the mirror to a chest and whatever you put in front of it appears inside. Endermen do this without a mirror.
research.primeva.primeval_armor.page1: The armor of the ancient alchemists, stronger than netherite. The full set grants Resistance, protects from miasma and strengthens the body.
research.primeva.primeval_tools.page1: A pickaxe that mines a 3x3 area. Fast enough to dig out a fortress in an afternoon.
research.primeva.eclipse_reaper.page1: The Umbral Blade awakens and grows into a scythe. It reaps in an area, drains life and leaves its wielder's soul a little darker.
research.primeva.archmage_crown.page1: The crown of those who mastered the six essences. It grants flight, night vision and double insight when studying the world.
research.primeva.golemancy.page1: Clay has no will, but it learns to obey. Give the golem a chest to call home, a seal to tell it what to do and, if you like, a filter to tell it what to take.
research.primeva.advanced_seals.page1: The Guard Seal turns the golem into a sentinel. The Stocking Seal makes it a warehouse helper, carrying items to the chests that already store that kind.
research.primeva.golem_cores.page1: An essence core gives the golem a specialty: speed, reach, strength or carrying space. Only one fits per golem.
research.primeva.infusion.page2:
How to keep a ritual stable:
- Place pedestals in pairs, facing each other.
- Fill jars with the recipe's essences before starting.
- Use Containment Pillars and Runic Stabilizers.
- Avoid rituals in areas full of miasma.
research.primeva.miasma.page2:
Miasma levels:
20+: the soil starts to rot.
25+: plants die.
40+: hunger and thick fog.
55+: Miasma Wraiths.
80+: Miasmal Surges.
Staying long in heavy miasma also corrupts the mind.
research.primeva.crimson_cult.page2: Reading the Crimson Rites teaches a lot, but clouds the mind. Heavily corrupted minds attract cult ambushes.
tooltip.primeva.arrow_lumen: Makes the target glow through walls.
tooltip.primeva.set_voidsteel: Night Vision and Strength I, but the void whispers (+1 mind every 10 min)
tooltip.primeva.cloud_ring: In inventory: Jump Boost II and no fall deals more than 2 hearts.
tooltip.primeva.mind_mirror: Use to see how corrupted your mind is.
tooltip.primeva.cleansing_soap: Scrub to wash away all temporary mind corruption.
tooltip.primeva.astral_sextant: Use under open sky: by day it gives Lumen, Ember and Gale; at night Umbra, Gale and Tide. Double on a full moon.
tooltip.primeva.decaying_brain: Eating it teaches Umbra... and clouds the mind.
tooltip.primeva.focus_flame: A 7-block cone of fire that burns everything ahead.
tooltip.primeva.focus_radiance: Heals you (3 hearts) and allies, and burns nearby undead.
msg.primeva.mirror_stage.2: Whispers, visions and wraiths that hunt you.
msg.primeva.mirror_stage.3: Now also a hunger that won't go away.
msg.primeva.mirror_stage.4: The Crimson Cult may ambush you!
msg.primeva.mirror_stage.5: Nightmares. Drink a Lucidity Tonic soon.
msg.primeva.sextant_sky: You need to see the open sky.
msg.primeva.sextant_day: The sun reveals Lumen, Ember and Gale.
msg.primeva.sextant_night: The stars reveal Umbra, Gale and Tide.
msg.primeva.sextant_fullmoon: The full moon doubles what you learn!
clue.primeva.do.warp: Suffer an effect of a corrupted mind
research.primeva.sanity.desc: The Mind Mirror shows how corrupted you are. Cleansing Soap (crucible) washes away temporary corruption.
research.primeva.sanity.page1: Every alchemist ends up hearing things. The secret is knowing when to stop. The mirror does not lie: it shows the size of the shadow you carry.
research.primeva.warding.desc: The Warding Stone stops monsters from spawning naturally within 24 blocks. Redstone turns it off.
research.primeva.warding.page1: Lumen and Terra, bound in carved stone, form a border the creatures of the night cannot cross when they are born.
research.primeva.astronomy.desc: The Astral Sextant turns the sky into insight. Day: Lumen, Ember and Gale. Night: Umbra, Gale and Tide. Full moon doubles it; storms give extra Gale.
research.primeva.astronomy.page1: The sky is the largest bookshelf in the world. The sun writes in Lumen, the stars write in Umbra, and those who can read learn for free.
research.primeva.essence_arrows.desc: Throw normal arrows into the crucible with essence: each arrow becomes 2 Essence Arrows, each with an effect.
research.primeva.essence_arrows.page1: Ember burns, Tide binds, Terra weighs, Gale lifts, Lumen reveals and Umbra rots. Pick the right arrow for each enemy.
research.primeva.elder_bow.desc: A bow of elder wood and arcanite: arrows 50% stronger and 30% faster. Takes bow enchantments.
research.primeva.elder_bow.page1: Elder wood is hard as bone and supple as wind. Cult hunters would pay dearly for one of these.
research.primeva.cloud_ring.desc: In inventory: Jump Boost II and no fall deals more than 2 hearts.
research.primeva.cloud_ring.page1: A piece of sky trapped in a silver band. Its wearer jumps like a rabbit and falls like a feather.
research.primeva.arcane_lamps.desc: Lamp of Growth: speeds up crops and saplings within 6 blocks. Lamp of Fertility: makes adult animals breed (up to 12 of each kind). Redstone turns them off.
research.primeva.arcane_lamps.page1: The Arcane Lamp gives light; these also give life. A farm with them grows while you sleep.
research.primeva.levitation.desc: The Gale Levitator pushes up anything above it (up to 10 blocks). Sneak to drift down slowly. Redstone turns it off.
research.primeva.levitation.page1: Stairs are for those who do not know Gale. A column of trapped wind replaces any elevator.
research.primeva.voidsteel_armor.desc: Armor that repairs itself. The full set grants Night Vision and Strength I, but slowly corrupts the mind.
research.primeva.voidsteel_armor.page1: To wear the void is to hear the void. The armor never breaks, but it is never silent either.
gui.primeva.guide_hint: How the mod works, from start to finish
guide.primeva.start.title: First steps
guide.primeva.start.text:
1. Make Arcane Dust: redstone + glowstone dust + lapis lazuli (makes 3).
2. Make this Grimoire: book + Arcane Dust + feather. Or throw Primordial Salt on a bookshelf.
3. Make the Lens of Perception: 3 gold, 1 glass pane and 1 Arcane Dust.
4. Hold right click with the Lens aimed at blocks, mobs or an item in your other hand. Each new thing teaches you its essences.
5. Make Research Scrolls: paper + Arcane Dust + ink sac (makes 2).
6. Open the Infusion tab and research Infusion. From there the whole tree opens up.

Tip: hold Shift and use the Lens with no target to see the local miasma.
guide.primeva.essences.title: Essences and insight
guide.primeva.essences.text:
Everything in the world is made of 6 essences:
Ember - fire and heat
Lumen - light and gold
Gale - air and motion
Tide - water and life
Terra - stone and plants
Umbra - shadow and death

They form a Cycle: Ember > Lumen > Gale > Tide > Terra > Umbra > Ember. Each one neighbors the two beside it.

Insight is how much you know of each essence. Research spends it. To get more:
- examine new things with the Lens (each thing counts once);
- use the Astral Sextant under open sky;
- put phials or crystals on the Study Table;
- corrupted-mind visions and the Decaying Brain also teach.

The tooltip of an examined item shows its essences.
guide.primeva.research.title: Research
guide.primeva.research.text:
Each research has:
- Prerequisites: other research first.
- Clues (Discoveries): something to do in the world, such as examining, holding an item, killing a mob or using a machine.
- An insight cost.
Some also need an advancement.

When everything is ready, click Start research. A hex board opens:
- Link every anchor essence into one network.
- Two neighboring cells only link if they are the same essence or neighbors in the Cycle.
- Left click places the chosen essence, right click removes.
- Each placed essence costs 2 insight.
- Finishing spends 1 Research Scroll.

Forbidden research (purple warning) leaves a permanent mark on the mind.
guide.primeva.distilling.title: Distilling and jars
guide.primeva.distilling.text:
Essence Distiller: 3 iron, 3 bricks, 1 cauldron and 1 Arcane Dust.
- Put fire, lava, magma or a lit campfire below it.
- Click it with items to distill them.
- With 5 or more of one essence, click with an Empty Phial to fill it.
- Sneak empty-handed to take the item out.
- Distilling creates a little miasma.

Empty Phials: glass bottle + Arcane Dust. Crystal shards also become phials at the crafting table.

Jars hold one essence and keep it when broken. Click with a phial to pour, or with an empty phial to fill.
Tubes carry essence from the Distiller to Jars. Filter Tubes only let one essence through.
guide.primeva.crucible.title: Crucible
guide.primeva.crucible.text:
Throw Primordial Salt into a water cauldron to create the Arcane Crucible. Like the Distiller, it needs heat below.

- Items thrown in dissolve into essence.
- A catalyst thrown in, with the right essence stored, becomes the recipe result.
- If essence is missing, the crucible pulls it from linked Jars.
- Recipes appear in the Grimoire pages once researched.

Examples: amber, quicksilver, arcanite ingot, Essence Arrows, Lucidity Tonic and Cleansing Soap.

Careful: overflowing or emptying the crucible on the ground creates miasma.
guide.primeva.infusion.title: Infusion and rituals
guide.primeva.infusion.text:
1. Put the central item on the Altar.
2. Put the offerings on Pedestals within 4 blocks.
3. Keep Jars full of the recipe's essence within 6 blocks.
4. Click the Altar with the Grimoire.

The ritual drains essence from the jars. If it runs out, it hungers and instability rises.
Instability grows over time and causes mishaps. Past its limit the ritual COLLAPSES: half the offerings are lost, miasma and wraiths are released, you take damage and your mind is corrupted.

To stabilize:
- pedestals in pairs, facing each other;
- Containment Pillars (every 3 remove 1);
- Runic Stabilizers (up to 8);
- avoid places full of miasma.

Tier II rituals need 4 pillars. Tier III needs 8 pillars and the Catalyst under the Altar.
guide.primeva.miasma.title: Miasma
guide.primeva.miasma.text:
Miasma is the residue of essence torn out by force: distilling, the crucible and rituals create miasma in the chunk.

20+: the soil rots.
25+: plants die.
40+: hunger and purple fog.
55+: Miasma Wraiths appear.
80+: Miasmal Surges.
Staying long in heavy miasma also corrupts the mind.

Corruption Sites are places in the world born full of miasma.

To clean it:
- Purifying Beacon: removes miasma from its chunk and the neighbors (Lumen phials speed it up);
- Purifying Incense: quickly cleans an area.
guide.primeva.mind.title: Corrupted mind
guide.primeva.mind.text:
The mind appears in the Grimoire footer as permanent+temporary.

Permanent: comes from forbidden research.
Temporary: ritual collapses, Crimson Rites, heavy miasma, the Decaying Brain and void armor. It fades on its own.

Effects by total:
3+: whispers
8+: visions (grant insight)
12+: wraiths
18+: hunger
25+: Crimson Cult ambushes
35+: nightmares

Cures:
- Cleansing Soap: clears the temporary part;
- Lucidity Tonic: clears the temporary part and 1 permanent.
The Mind Mirror shows your level.
guide.primeva.magic.title: Wands and foci
guide.primeva.magic.text:
Elemental wands (one per essence) cast spells with right click. The durability bar is the charge. When it runs out, the wand drinks a phial of its essence from your inventory.
Ember: fireballs. Tide: healing. Terra: digs a 3x3x3 area. Gale: dash. Lumen: light and reveals enemies. Umbra: drains life.

Foci work the same way, with more specific spells:
Frost, Shock, Excavation, Exchange, Portable Hole, Flame and Radiance.

The Essence Amulet in your inventory sometimes saves charge.
guide.primeva.golems.title: Golems
guide.primeva.golems.text:
1. Make an Arcane Golem (infusion) and use it on a chest. That chest becomes its home.
2. Click the golem with a Seal to give it a job:
- Harvest: harvests and replants.
- Pickup: collects items from the ground.
- Lumber: chops trees.
- Guard: attacks monsters.
- Stocking: carries items to chests that already store that kind.
3. Sneak-click with an item to add it to the filter (empty filter = takes everything).
4. A Core gives a specialty: speed, reach, strength or capacity. Only one fits.

The golem works within 10 blocks of its home and delivers everything to the chest.
guide.primeva.gear.title: Equipment
guide.primeva.gear.text:
Metals: Arcanite (crucible), Primeval Metal (infusion) and Voidsteel (crucible, repairs itself).

Armor with full set bonuses:
- Arcanite: +25% mining and +10% speed.
- Crimson: +3 damage, heals on hit and Strength at night.
- Voidsteel: Night Vision and Strength, but corrupts the mind.
- Primeval: +4 hearts, Resistance and miasma immunity.

Trinkets (just keep them in your inventory): Runic Ring (shield), Cloud Ring, Steadfast Girdle, Essence Amulet and Verdant Charm.

Weapons and tools: elemental tools, Umbral Blade, Elder Bow with Essence Arrows, grapple, Pocket Mirror and, at the end, the Eclipse Reaper and the Archmage Crown.
guide.primeva.world.title: The world
guide.primeva.world.text:
Ores:
- Vermilion: Y -48 to 48. Drops quicksilver.
- Amber: Y 16 to 112.
- Essence crystals: colored clusters in caves, Y -56 to 48. They drop shards.

Trees: Argent Tree (pale glowing wood) and Elder Tree (dark wood).

Corruption Sites: purple surface areas full of miasma.

Crimson Cult: cultists appear at night with scythes. They drop crimson cloth, loot bags and the Crimson Rites. With the Herald Sigil you summon the boss, the Crimson Herald.

Zombies sometimes drop a Decaying Brain.
Chests in dungeons, temples and strongholds hold mod items.
